body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: e7050be171c317412fb52973496df1983b1efa55 -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge** (non-blocking notes below).

**What looks good**
- The #2121 repro (Contour/Slot with a clearance plane inside the stock) is convicted at the traverse, carries the `Clearance in stock:` note, and `post_setup` / `post_setup_unwritten` refuse and write nothing. The same plane after a Face to Z 5 is clean and posts; a Face that stops above the plane does not excuse it.
- The law change is a pure widening: `rapids.rs` only drops the `low >= clearance` skip, so no rapid refused before is allowed now. Both re-reads only `retain`-remove convictions, only for upright lateral rapids at/above the plane; rapids under the plane keep their old convictions.
- Re-reads fail closed: non-finite numbers, posed rapids, Radial/Revolve/Rotary, open shells, no solid, a flute over nothing, unknown fidelity, oversize grid, NaN column height all keep the conviction. Adversarial reading: `traverse_solids` clips each facet (vertical walls included) to the swept rectangle, reads every tool band at its own radius, lifts by model excess; a wall within the radius, a boss under the holder, a slope met by the rim and a stepped stock keep the conviction in the unit tests. `prior_traverse` reads the capsule (padded by half a cell diagonal) at the rapid's low end; a column an earlier op only partly cleared (rim 0.1 mm over raw) keeps it, and the part must stand under the tip too. Own cuts only lower the column, so a prior-grid clear cannot clear what the law convicted on the post-own-cut column.
- Creation flags rather than refuses, but the post is still held: the verdict is the per-rapid `RapidInStock` at Generate and the post gate refuses on it (pinned by the post tests). Acceptable: the door cannot see where rapids run, and refusing would have refused four standing fixtures. MCP add/edit answer with `warning`.
- No golden or snapshot PNG changed. One existing test changed (`operations.rs` slot fixture now carries both height notes), reason stated. Decision file present, no new crate dependency, no build.rs/.github/Cargo changes, provenance lines present.

**Results** (locally on macOS, trial-merged with upstream/main 57f2ffbbf; no workflow dispatched)
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: sim suites ok (incl. the new `verify::` unit tests), motion ok, app suites ok (680 s; includes `clearance_in_stock`, `operations`, `stock_source_holes`, `stepped_stock_*`, `vertical_rapid_stock`, `warned_moves`).
- ui suites: compile error on the trial merge, not caused by this PR: `crates/ui/src/machine_modes.rs:43` `match kind` lacks `Kind::Waterjet` (E0004). The file is untouched here and upstream/main's `short_caption` has no Waterjet arm either, so main's ui lib is broken on its own. On the PR head without the merge: `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib -- warning_fold` 6 passed, and `cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` is clean.
- Mutation table in the body: plausible against the pins I read; I did not re-run each mutation.
- Merge with main: clean today. If #2129 (#1559) lands first, its edited tests that assert exact path notes may meet the new `Clearance in stock:` note.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
1. Cached paths: the op stamp salt was not bumped (the PR says so). A project saved before this fix keeps its cached path and warnings until regenerated, so an old cached program with a plane inside the stock still reads Ok and can post. The maintainer may want a stamp bump (re-stales every op) or a release-notes line.
2. `prior_clear` treats a capsule that falls wholly off the prior grid as air. That holds while the grid covers the judged stock (it is built from the setup stock; carried overhang is widened elsewhere), but the older `acquit_by_prior` reads an off-grid disc as unknown. A guard requiring the rapid's end to lie on the grid would make the two consistent; I could not construct a failing case.
3. Main's ui crate does not build on `Kind::Waterjet` (above) - worth its own issue if none exists.
4. The UI does not show the creation word yet (#2131), as stated.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
